hypothesis: Canonical filename-based species-pair collection removes verified worker-arrival sensitivity without changing the accepted HMM hit multiset. Complete downstream evaluation is needed to establish biological effects, including neutrality or regressions, before subsequent accuracy and speed experiments use it as a reproducible base.
inputs: Use the completed fresh control100 OrthoBench numeric checkpoint and its native products; use the retained admitted corrected-QfO and Three Kingdoms native numeric checkpoints with their corresponding factorial/satellite native baselines. Do not use mutable products of running jobs. Record actual paths and hashes in an immutable execution plan.
mechanism: Validate checkpoint species labels against full FASTA ownership. Reorder only whole contiguous, unique accepted-hit species-pair blocks by lexicographic (query FASTA filename, target FASTA filename), preserving every within-block row, index and score. This reproduces the production canonical collector for accepted hits; it is not the earlier numeric-species block audit or global gene-pair sorting. Arrival preserves the original checkpoint sequence. No fabricated E-values, rescaling, deduplication, significance retesting or reference labels in inference.
downstream: For each arm, replay RBNH graph, singleton assignment, one strict profile-HMM expansion pass, default refinement, satellite_v2 candidate expansion and inferred-species-tree native reconciliation using species_overlap, positive_paralogy and min_variance. Use existing proven replay and scoring helpers. Reuse only content-compatible immutable baseline raw-tree checkpoints and record reuse; changed candidate families receive new trees. Keep legacy support transport and full-clear CPU libraries unchanged so ordering is the sole mechanism.
control_gate: Require arrival candidate partition and membership-constraint hashes to match its retained native baseline, then require exact RootHOG, pair, confidence and rooted species-tree products. Validate all stage partitions against the complete unique gene universe and native pair ownership/counts. Preserve and diagnose any mismatch, rather than silently accepting a new control. If a dataset control fails, retain its failure and continue independent datasets, but do not score or interpret its canonical arm.
selection: Report endpoint-specific changes and Pareto tradeoffs, precision/recall, coverage, native pair/group counts and failures. A 0.005 decline is a development screening tolerance only. Functional means and FAS sampling variation are not proof of orthology accuracy or equivalence. No default promotion from this round alone.

resources.concurrency: One downstream task, datasets and arms sequential; existing primary jobs and unrelated workloads untouched.

timing_scope: Incremental accepted-hit replay and selective tree-cache reuse, not fresh initial-search or isolated full-pipeline timing. Record shared-host activity and per-stage wall/CPU/RSS descriptively.
validity: All three datasets are development-exposed. QfO's 78 species activates the broad-panel refinement branch. Three Kingdoms and TreeFam remain supplementary/supporting evidence. The same inference settings apply across datasets. These results do not establish independent generalization.
git: Commit and push this plan before evaluation; freeze tested code, input/scorer/runtime/library hashes and execution commands. Commit and push validated results or explicit failures at meaningful milestones.
